players.product: system-level test (SLT) platforms for AI accelerators and power test equipment

quarterly_data.signal: Customer case (company release): Chroma's SimuEV full-vehicle test platform helped CMC (China Motor Corporation) establish a high-power laboratory for virtual vehicle testing of its electric vehicles, integrating Power HIL and dynamometer test platforms - a Power HIL platform for the on-board charger and DC-DC converter, a dyno bench with two motor DUTs, an air-conditioning test system, a battery simulator and a physical battery - so subsystems can be validated together at full-vehicle level before road testing.
